notes: Single +3.3 V supply (3.0–3.6 V recommended). Input optical power –31 to –14 dBm specified at BER ≤ 1×10⁻¹⁰ with 62.5/125 µm NA=0.275 or 50/125 µm NA=0.20 MMF; transmitter on for crosstalk. Output optical power ranges differ by fiber: 62.5/125 µm –20 to –14 dBm; 50/125 µm –23.5 to –14 dBm (average). Signaling rate 125 Mbaud, Fast Ethernet 4B/5B; Ethernet auto-negotiation pulses not supported. Typical characterization at TC=25 °C, VCC=3.3 V. Power dissipation tabulated separately for transmitter and receiver sections (PDISS mW). Spectral width FWHM typical 147 nm.
suggestions: Datasheet gives 100 Mbps Fast Ethernet via 125 Mbaud 4B/5B but not bit_rate_gbps field explicitly. Consider mapping Mbaud row to bit_rate_gbps when standard is cited. MMF NA values (0.275, 0.20) could be a future fiber qualifier field.
